paragraphs: I combined several different technologies to create an engaging experience: a 3D character that tracks the viewer with its gaze and responds to a set of predefined topics.

Technical summary: I use YOLO for real-time face tracking and microphone activity detection. The microphone stream is sent to ElevenLab for speech processing; the returned audio is routed into Unity, which drives gaze direction and lip-sync animations based on YOLO tracking and the audio feed.

Personal note: Integrating multiple languages and tools (C#, Python, web APIs) can feel complex, but lightweight web-based communication layers keep the system manageable and unlock significant creative possibilities.
